title: Dry Run - Digital Arrest Scam Practice Drill
disclaimer: Practice, not protection. Never claim it measures real-world vulnerability, prevents fraud, or is validated.

hero.headline: Practice Before You Get Scammed
hero.subheadline: A kind and realistic drill for digital arrest scam calls. Experience the intimidation in a safe space and learn the one habit that saves you.

facts.headline: The Reality of Digital Arrest
facts.stat_label: estimated losses to digital arrest and intimidation scams in India annually.

steps.title: Send a Private Link
steps.description: An organizer creates a private invite link for their family member.

steps.title: Take the Drill Call
steps.description: The participant takes a simulated call from a fictional officer of a fictional agency.

steps.title: Receive Kind Debrief
steps.description: A kind analysis highlights where compliance happened and reinforces safe habits.

items.title: Hang Up Immediately
items.description: Real law enforcement officers never hold court or threaten arrest over video calls.

items.title: Verify via Official Channels
items.description: Call the national cybercrime helpline 1930 or visit an official police station.

items.title: Talk to Family
items.description: Scammers demand secrecy. Breaking isolation immediately breaks the scam.

footer.notice: Dry Run is an educational practice drill. It does not certify security or guarantee fraud prevention.
